subject.title: [Feature]: Pipeline workflows for the workboard plugin

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a bundled Workboard-native pipeline product, or keep durable stage orchestration in external code plugins built on TaskFlow with Workboard used only for optional visibility?
rationale: This is not a missing bug fix: it chooses whether to add a substantial orchestration layer to a bundled plugin despite existing TaskFlow functionality and the repository’s explicit guardrail against duplicative heavy orchestration.

options.title: Keep orchestration plugin-owned
options.body: Ask for an external code-plugin prototype using managed TaskFlow and existing Workboard coordination surfaces, then evaluate only demonstrated missing extension seams.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow Workboard API design
options.body: Approve a design discussion only if maintainers want native board progression, beginning with the smallest public API needed rather than three new agent tools and a general pipeline engine.

options.title: Decline bundled pipeline ownership
options.body: Close the direction if maintainers intend Workboard to remain a small local operating board and TaskFlow to remain the orchestration substrate.

recommendation.title: Keep orchestration plugin-owned
recommendation.body: Ask for an external code-plugin prototype using managed TaskFlow and existing Workboard coordination surfaces, then evaluate only demonstrated missing extension seams.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Workboard history makes Vincent Koc the best available first routing candidate for the Workboard ownership decision.
